description: This class is a Spring MVC controller managing customer account actions such as login, viewing and editing account details, password management, billing address, and customer attributes within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: CustomerAccountController
classes.description: Controller for managing customer account related endpoints such as login, profile viewing/editing, password change, address management, and attribute updates in an e-commerce setting.

methods.name: displayLogon
methods.description: Displays the login page for customers.

methods.name: displayCustomerAccount
methods.description: Displays the customer's account overview page.

methods.name: displayCustomerChangePassword
methods.description: Displays the password change form for authenticated customers.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Processes the password change request, validating current password and updating to the new one.

methods.name: saveCustomerAttributes
methods.description: Handles saving or updating customer attributes via AJAX.

methods.name: displayCustomerBillingAddress
methods.description: Displays the billing address of the customer.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Loads the form to edit a specific address (billing/shipping).

methods.name: updateCustomerAddress
methods.description: Handles the submission for updating customer address information.
